study_identification_part.si_4_title: Molecular and micro-architectural mapping of gray matter alterations in psychosis

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used 8 datasets for psychosis-related and healthy control samples: ABCD (Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development), ALSPAC (Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children), ASRB (Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank), B-SNIP (Bipolar-Schizophrenia Network on Intermediate Phenotypes), CNP/LA5c (UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics), MCIC (Mental Illness and Neuroscience Discovery Institute Clinical Imaging Consortium), PAFIP (Programa de Atencion a las Fases Iniciales de Psicosis), and UK Biobank. Additionally, the normative model was pre-trained using lifespan brain charts from Bethlehem et al. (2022) which included ~120,000 participants from 100 different studies.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "MRI from individuals with chronic schizophrenia (SCZ; n = 525; age = 37.63 +/- 12.06) and schizoaffective disorder (SAD; n = 62; age = 33.77 +/- 10.78)... were obtained from Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD), Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB), Bipolar-Schizophrenia Network on Intermediate Phenotypes (B-SNIP), UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP) LA5c Study, Mental Illness and Neuroscience Discovery (MIND) Institute Clinical Imaging Consortium (MCIC), and UK Biobank (UKB)"; "MRI data from individuals who were determined to have experienced a first episode of psychosis (FEP; n = 352)... were obtained from Programa de Atencion a las Fases Iniciales de Psicosis (PAFIP)"; "Individuals who were suspected of having had psychotic experiences (PEs)... were sourced from Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC)"; "This model... estimated cross-sectional normative age-related trends from 100 different studies (around 120,000 participants)"

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The study used a pre-trained normative model (GAMLSS) from Bethlehem et al. (2022) to compute centile scores. The 8 clinical datasets provided patient groups (SCZ, SAD, FEP, PE, relatives) and local healthy controls for centile computation and group comparisons. The normative model was not re-trained; rather, out-of-sample centile scores were computed using the pre-existing model.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "To benchmark regional volumes of each psychosis-related diagnosis and group against normative trajectories, we used a generalized additive model for location, scale, and shape (GAMLSS). This model... estimated cross-sectional normative age-related trends from 100 different studies (around 120,000 participants)"; "The out-of-sample centile method used here enabled us to calculate centiles without the need to re-train the model on the ~120,000 subjects used for the original normative curves"

answer.note: The study also included 38,696 healthy controls from 8 datasets (ABCD: 8,762; ASRB: 177; B-SNIP: 93; LA5c: 121; MCIC: 90; UK Biobank: 28,989; PAFIP: 195; ALSPAC: 269) for centile comparison with patients, but these were not used to train the normative model.

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: This study used a pre-trained normative model from Bethlehem et al. (2022), which was built using approximately 120,000 participants from 100 different studies spanning the entire lifespan (from 17 post-conception weeks to 100 years). The study did not re-train this model. The 38,696 healthy controls from the 8 datasets were used for comparison/benchmarking purposes (computing centile scores for patients vs. HCs), not for training. HC total calculation: 38,232 (main group from ABCD, ASRB, B-SNIP, LA5c, MCIC, UKB) + 195 (PAFIP) + 269 (ALSPAC) = 38,696.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "This model, available at https://github.com/brainchart/Lifespan, estimated cross-sectional normative age-related trends from 100 different studies (around 120,000 participants)"; "Healthy controls (n = 38,232; age = 51.91 +/- 23.68) comprised individuals from previous datasets without any current or previous psychotic disorder"; "The out-of-sample centile method used here enabled us to calculate centiles without the need to re-train the model on the ~120,000 subjects used for the original normative curves"; Supplementary Table 1 shows separate HC counts for each cohort

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The pre-trained normative model from Bethlehem et al. (2022) spans the entire lifespan from 17 post-conception weeks to 100 years. Detailed age statistics (mean, SD, median, IQR) for the ~120,000 participants used to build the normative model are not reported in this paper but are available in the original Bethlehem et al. (2022) publication. The local healthy control samples used for comparison include: main HC (n=38,232): mean=51.91+/-23.68 years, range 9.76-81.82; PAFIP HC (n=195): mean=30.64+/-7.66 years, range 16.78-52.80; ALSPAC HC (n=269): mean=22.30+/-1.46 years, range 19.78-24.78.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "A key benefit of this method, compared to other normative models used in schizophrenia, lies in its extensive dataset (more than 120,000 scans) that spans the entire lifespan, from 17 post-conception weeks to 100 years"; "Healthy controls (n = 38,232; age = 51.91 +/- 23.68)"; Supplementary Table 1: "HC | 38,232 (19,139) | 51.91 +/- 23.68 (9.76, 81.82)"; "HC | 195 (75) | 30.64 +/- 7.66 (16.78, 52.80) | PAFIP"; "HC | 269 (154) | 22.30 +/- 1.46 (19.78, 24.78) | ALSPAC"

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Sex distribution for the ~120,000 participants used to build the pre-trained normative model (Bethlehem et al. 2022) is not reported in this paper. For the local healthy control samples used for comparison: main HC group (n=38,232) had 19,139 females (50.0%); PAFIP HC (n=195) had 75 females (38.5%); ALSPAC HC (n=269) had 154 females (57.2%). Total local HC: 38,696 with 19,368 females (50.1%).
